title: The Apothecary Diaries Director Breaks Silence on Biggest Change in Season 3
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is taking all the spotlight this Fall 2026 anime season with its exciting Season 3. There’s no denying it’s one of the biggest shows of the 2020s, not only within the Seinen demographic but also compared to all the major genres as well. The anime returned a year after the second season reached its bittersweet conclusion, with Maomao leaving the Rear Palace after the Shi Clan’s rebellion failed. With over 57 million copies in circulation, the series has an anime adaptation and even a live-action in the works , along with the ongoing light novel and manga. Written by Natsu Hyuga, the story is loved for its complex themes, clever mystery format, and political intrigue.

Maomao is considered one of the best protagonists in recent years, and there’s no denying she deserves all the praise. While the anime is currently airing its third season , fans can’t ignore the considerable changes made in the anime, especially with the way the story is progressing. The change happened significantly in the second season finale, which features the aftermath of the rebellion. Not long after the premiere of the third season, the anime director shared his thoughts on the story’s progress so far.

The Apothecary Diaries Director Sheds Light on Season 3

In an interview with Mantan Web , Akinori Fudesaka shares, “As the story progresses, the setting gradually shifts westward, so we’ve made subtle, gradual changes in everything from the climate and culture to the color of the earthen walls of the buildings, and even the colors and structure of the clothes the characters wear.”

He also continues, “Up until now, we’ve been able to use generic materials from places like the royal court, but that becomes unusable once we move west. When we started production on the third season, I asked the producer and setting designers to ‘prioritize the art commissioning above all else.”

Fudesaka served as a director in the second season and returned in the third season as well . While it’s obvious that the tone of the story has changed, he also mentions the gradual changes in the color schemes and the clothing of the characters, which point towards a different season and vibe. The characters’ lives have changed significantly in the latest season, but it’s not just their social status. While the first two seasons centered mostly around the Rear Palace, the story is now leaning more towards the neighboring countries, which is the major reason behind the change in color scheme.

What’s Happening in The Apothecary Diaries Season 3?

The second season finale already confirmed that the story will take a major turn after Maomao and Jinshi returned to the capital . The latest season is adapting the fifth volume of the novel, where Maomao had already left the Palace. She is now working as an apothecary at the Verdigris House while her adoptive father, Luomen, has returned to the Imperial Palace as the Court Physician. Not only that, but Jinshi has abandoned his fake identity as a eunuch and the manager of the Rear Palace.

As the Moon Prince and officially the Emperor’s younger brother, Jinshi has now taken on his royal duties at the court. The third season is split into two cours, with the second one scheduled to premiere in April next year as part of the Spring 2027 anime lineup. The latest season opens up with a major crisis as a locust problem leads to a potential food crisis and famine scare. Maomao notices something is strange, and it’s no surprise she wants to get to the bottom of the mystery, which will be of great help to Jinshi.

What are your thoughts on The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 so far? Let us know in the comments below!

content:

He has also written scripts for live-action series such as Taiyō ni Hoero! , Hagure Keiji: Junjōha , Sasurai Keiji Ryojо̄-hen , and Bengoshi Takabayashi Ayuko .

title: Tim Burton’s Failed Sci-Fi Movie From the ’90s Could Have Been a Game Changer for Manga
content:
Tim Burton has made a career out of making weirdos look cool. Beetlejuice is a walking bad decision. Edward Scissorhands has blenders for hands. Sweeney Todd’s demon barber speaks for itself. Burton understood the appeal of outsiders long before Hollywood started turning every comic-book character into a billion-dollar franchise. The director eventually developed an interest in a Japanese sci-fi story about a teenage girl with psychic powers. It’s a fairly common concept in the world of manga and anime, and it is plenty ripe for a Tim Burton twist.

The really crazy part? A new wave band was already trying to turn the same story into a musical. Yes, a manga musical. Because apparently Hollywood hadn’t made things complicated enough. The project had a studio, a director, and some genuinely unusual creative minds behind it. It also arrived at a time when American audiences were only beginning to discover Japanese comics. Had the movie happened, it might have introduced a whole lot of people to manga years before anime became a regular part of pop culture. Instead, one of the strangest potential blockbusters of the ’90s disappeared into Hollywood’s enormous filing cabinet of what-ifs.

Tim Burton Almost Made Mai, the Psychic Girl Into a Movie

The manga was Mai, the Psychic Girl . It was written by Kazuya Kudo and drawn by Ryoichi Ikegami. Mai Kuju is a teenage girl with psychic powers, and a secret organization wants to control her abilities. It sounds a lot like one of my favorite Japanese stories of all time: Akira . The obvious difference is that Mai is a girl, while Tetsuo and Kaneda are male. This could have been Burton’s first female protagonist. It wasn’t until later that he made Corpse Bride , Alice in Wonderland , Big Eyes , and others.

Think about the director’s work around this period. Edward Scissorhands was about a misunderstood outsider who couldn’t quite fit into suburbia. Batman Returns gave us a lonely billionaire, a bitter woman turned into Catwoman, and a villain who looked like he’d been assembled in a very unhappy basement. Burton liked strange characters with real pain underneath all the gothic window dressing. Mai would have fit right in.

And the timing was interesting, too. Carolco Pictures acquired the film rights in August 1991, with Burton attached to direct. The studio hoped to get production moving in 1992. Then Burton chose to work on The Nightmare Before Christmas and Ed Wood . The option expired, and the movie went nowhere. That’s a pretty spectacular near-miss. Burton made a stop-motion Halloween classic instead, so it’s hard to complain too much.

How a Lost Tim Burton Movie Could Have Changed Manga in America

Here’s where things get interesting. Mai, the Psychic Girl wasn’t some obscure Japanese comic that nobody outside Japan had heard of. It was among the early manga series published in English, with Viz and Eclipse Comics bringing it to American readers in 1987. Manga was still a niche interest in the United States. You couldn’t walk into a bookstore and find entire walls devoted to it. For many readers, discovering a Japanese comic was a bit like finding a secret door in a familiar room. There was a whole world on the other side, and most people hadn’t even noticed the handle.

Now imagine a Tim Burton movie introducing that world to a much larger audience. Burton was a major name after Batman and Edward Scissorhands . A film based on Mai could have sent curious viewers looking for the original manga. It might have encouraged publishers to take more chances on Japanese comics, too. Hollywood has a long history of turning promising ideas into expensive curiosities. But the opportunity was there, and the project had another wonderfully odd twist.

Ron and Russell Mael of Sparks had spent years trying to turn Mai into a musical. Their experience eventually helped inspire The Seduction of Ingmar Bergman , a radio musical about the frustrations of getting a project made. So even the failure became material for something else. Manga would eventually find a huge American audience without Burton’s help. But imagine if he’d been one of the people who opened that door. But there is one caveat. The only issue the movie would have faced would’ve most likely been the miscasting of Mai from Japanese to Caucasian.

Rumor had it that Burton was planning on casting Winona Ryder at the time. Still, this will always be a monumental what-if in Hollywood history and for both American and Japanese culture at large. Would you have wanted to see Tim Burton taking on this manga classic? Let us know your thoughts in the comments!

title: Shigeru Miyamoto Becomes 1st Game Creator to be Honored With Japan's Order of Culture Award
content:
At a press conference at Nintendo in Kyoto, Miyamoto stated that as games are created by not just one person, but by many collaborating together, he honors their work with this award.

The Emperor will present Miyamoto with the award on November 3, Japan's Culture Day.

Miyamoto is the main designer of the first incarnations of some of Nintendo 's most celebrated, well-known, and long-running game franchises, including Mario Bros. , Donkey Kong , The Legend of Zelda , Pikmin , and Star Fox , and continued to be a main designer for some of those franchise 's later games. He also helped shape the concept behind the Wii, one of Nintendo 's most successful console platforms. He has the title of Representative Director and Creative Fellow at Nintendo .

Miyamoto earned Japan's Person of Cultural Merit honor in 2019. He also earned Spain's prestigious Prince of Asturias Award in the category of Communications and Humanities in 2012.

title: Seven Seas Licenses Secret Relationships Webtoon for Print Release in August 2027
content:
Seven Seas Entertainment announced on October 22 that it has licensed the Secret Relationships webtoon for English print release. The boys-love office romance webtoon has also been adapted into a live-action series.

The story follows Daon, who grew up in poverty and works hard to secure his financial future. His frugal habits frustrate his coworker Sunghyeon, but their relationship changes after Sunghyeon witnesses Daon's parents asking him for money at work. As the two grow closer, Daon must also confront his feelings for Jaemin, a former tutor and mentor, and a secret he has kept from others.

The live-action Secret Relationships series premiered in 2025 and is available to stream internationally, including in the United States, on iQIYI . The series stars WEi member Jun-seo Kim, Sun-hyung Cha, Jung-woo Cha, and Ho-young Kim .

Fans in the U.S. can watch the live-action Secret Relationships series now.

Seven Seas will release the first volume of the Secret Relationships print comic in large-trim print editions under its Seven Seas Webtoons label in August 2027. The volume will cost US$22.99 and CAD$30.99.

The English version of the Secret Relationships webtoon is available on Tapas . McQueen STUDIO drew the series, which ended in 2023.

The original webtoon surpassed 170 million views on Kakao Webtoon.

title: Korean-Animated Film Your Letter Begins Streaming on Crunchyroll
content:
The Korean-animated film Your Letter , based on Hyeon A Cho 's webtoon of the same name, began streaming on Crunchyroll on October 19. The film is available in Korean with subtitles in English and several other languages.

Fans can watch it here .

Directed by Yong-Hwan Kim and produced by Studio N and Studio LICO, the film opened in South Korean theaters on October 1, 2025. It also screened in the United States and Canada through Crunchyroll Anime Nights on August 17.

The original Your Letter webtoon ran on Naver WEBTOON in 2018 and concluded in 2019.

The story of the webtoon reads:

Sori is a special young girl - kind, caring and principled well beyond her years. Unfortunately, these are NOT the personality traits generally celebrated in middle school – especially Sori's, where she's bullied mercilessly for defending the defenseless until she herself becomes a target. To escape, she transfers to a new school where the same old problems begin to play out all over again – that is until a mysterious trail of letters leads Sori on a magical scavenger hunt through the hidden world that exists right below the surface of her new middle school. The mail trail is the work an anonymous guardian angel, whose mission seems to be to provide a soft landing for Sori at her new school. But who is this person? And why did he choose her? With each letter, secrets are revealed and bonds are formed - as Sori learns about friendship, flora, fauna and finding the good in people in this strange new environment.

The English version of the Your Letter webtoon is available on WEBTOON. Ize Press released the series in a single-volume print edition in July 2024.

title: Dragon Ball GT Gave Fans One Of The Coolest Villains (& They Need to Be Made Canon)
content:
The recent Dragon Ball canonization of fan-favorite characters and power levels needs to continue by adding in Dragon Ball GT ‘s favorite and only Tuffle, Baby. Dragon Ball GT didn’t deliver the same iconic villains as Frieza, Cell and Buu. The show’s direction seemed a mix between the lightheartedness of the original and the fight-heavy Dragon Ball Z . It did give the fans Baby, however, a villain with a compelling backstory and an awesome design.

A consequence of King Vegeta’s actions finally comes back to bite his son and the remaining Saiyans when Baby, a machine-organism hybrid , begins wreaking havoc across Earth. An egomaniac, King Vegeta had the Tuffles virtually exterminated when he and the other Saiyans ascended to great apes to kill off the race and take over the planet. An action that is certainly indefensible by the surviving Saiyans. Baby does not care, and much like Killmonger in Black Panther , he’s going to make the Saiyans pay. Even if this particular group of them had nothing to do with it. And that’s a story that would fit right into the canon.

Baby Takes It Up A Few Levels

Baby boasts a strength so powerful it handles Goku’s Super Saiyan 3 with ease. The Tuffle’s constantly growing power level jump mixed with Vegeta’s skill set makes for an incredible tandem. Baby starts as just a small childlike parasite that quickly jumps from character to character to gain more minions and their powers. He then taunts and takes over Vegeta, who he gives a facelift, and quickly ascends to essentially a Super Saiyan Tuffle or as he’s known to most fans of the series, Super Baby 2. The being manages to bring his planet back with the Dragon Balls, but he learns that Goku, even in a childlike physical state, is no easy out.

The Z Fighters leader harnesses the power of the Great Ape, contains it and slaps around Baby, before hurling him into the sun to remove the threat for good. Of course, that whole story doesn’t even exist anymore with Dragon Ball GT never being made canon and very few references made to the Tuffles. The next obvious step for this would be to focus on both of these specific stories.

Understandable Villain Offers Possible Plot Twist

The eradication of the Tuffles brings about an interesting story for the currently-living Saiyans. This plot wasn’t explored to the same depth in DBGT , as some of the more recent storylines. For instance, Broly’s arc became more of a tragic story that many could sympathize with including Goku. The Tuffles, although a tragic story in their own right, could be the reverse of the new Broly arc.

What does Goku do when his morals are challenged and potentially taken advantage of against a foe as cunning as Baby proved to be in Dragon Ball GT ? Would he manipulate that trait in Goku, or worse yet, find someone as diabolical as Frieza to combine with? Their disdain for the Saiyan race between those two, along with a Black Frieza transformation could create power levels we’ve not seen. Similar to how they scaled Broly’s power from the non-canon version to the current one, Baby could get the same boost.

Goku already got to make the jump to Super Saiyan 4 officially in Dragon Ball Daima , and he needed that to defeat Baby last time. Could he ascend further into the heights of Saiyan powers? Or would another non-canon ability like the use of the masks from Super Dragon Ball Heroes become Capsule Corp’s latest reimagined tech to give the Saiyans an edge? Either way, it creates a whole world of possibilities to infinitely explore.

The franchise just remastered Dragon Ball Super with Dragon Ball Super: Beerus , and a short story in Dragon Ball Daima in 2024. Those works are great, but further expansion on Super ‘s timeline hasn’t happened in quite some time. Would Dragon Ball fans welcome more world building or re-introducing to the series? Let us know in the comments.

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Original Score and Soundtrack Albums Released
content:
CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 has released two official music albums following the anime’s Netflix debut on October 20, including an original score by Tsuneo Imahori and a separate soundtrack featuring songs from Rico Nasty, Corbin, DOUDOU, BIJI and more. The songs are now available on major music streaming platforms .

The first release, CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 (Original Series Score) , features 39 tracks composed by Imahori. A second album, CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 (Original Series Soundtrack) , features eight original songs created specifically for the anime. The lineup includes “You Can’t Run From Me” by Rico Nasty, “A Rusty Dream” by DOUDOU, “Worth It” by Corbin, “Boya” by BIJI, and additional tracks from Petite Meller, Piernikowski, Kalman Chodakiewitz and Eli Shiffman.

The full soundtrack tracklist is:

• “Watson” featuring Oslo Green, by Petite Meller

• “You Can’t Run From Me” by Rico Nasty

• “Boya” by BIJI

• “High Forever” by Petite Meller

• “Da Mi Jeszce Jedna Szanse” by Piernikowski

• “In Love With Myself” by Kalman Chodakiewitz, Eli Shiffman and Petite Meller

• “A Rusty Dream” by DOUDOU

• “Worth It” by Corbin

Studio TRIGGER is back to animate. We recently spoke with the show’s writer and producer Bartosz Sztybor , who told us why they chose the studio and shared insights into the production.

The new anime is a new 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077 , earlier described as “a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge.” It is directed by Kai Ikarashi, who directed Episode 6 of the original anime titled “Girl on Fire.” Ichigo Kanno is the character designer, while screenplay will be handled by Masahiko Otsuka. Bartosz Sztybor is also back as showrunner, story writer, and producer. The anime was voted as the most anticipated Fall 2026 anime by Anime Corner’s followers.

Netflix is exclusively streaming the anime, while both music albums are available now through Milan Records. You can also read our review of the anime .
author: Anime Corner

title: Manhwa-Based Live-Action Series The Blue Road Releases Teaser Trailer Ahead of November 20 Premiere
content:
Netflix released a teaser trailer for The Blue Road , the manhwa -based live-action series , on Thursday. The series will premiere on Netflix on November 20 at 1:00 a.m. PST.

The teaser trailer introduces Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency detective Seok Kim (Seok-gu Son) and Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department detective Inose ( Eita Nagayama ) as they investigate what appears to be a series of connected murders in South Korea and Japan. Messages left at the crime scenes in both languages and disagreements over the investigation's direction set the stage for tensions between the two detectives.

Joon-hee Han, who previously helmed D.P. and Coin Locker Girl , is directing the series.

The live-action adaptation is based on the 2002 Korean-Japanese collaborative comic Purungil – Ao no Michi (Blue Road), written by Keishi Edogawa and drawn by Korean artist Kaya Kwon. The five-volume series blended hard-boiled crime storytelling with themes of cultural tension and cross-border cooperation, making it a distinctive work of its time.

The manhwa follows the investigation of a gruesome cross-border serial murder case. The story begins in Tokyo, where authorities discover a twisted, contorted corpse accompanied by a blood-written message in Korean. Shortly afterward, a similar crime scene emerges in South Korea—this time with a Japanese message written near the victim. The shocking parallels force law enforcement in both countries to recognize the crimes as linked, leading two detectives, one Korean and one Japanese, to join forces in pursuit of the killer.
author: ANN

title: Takopi’s Original Sin Movie Reveals Main Trailer With New Scenes, Key Visual and Tele Theme Song
content:
Takopi’s Original Sin -Thank You, See You Tomorrow- movie revealed a new key visual and main trailer ahead of its November 27, 2026 release in Japan. The anime originally ran from June 28 to August 1. It swept the weekly rankings every week during its run, taking five wins. The film will compile all six episodes of the anime series as a re-edited version created specifically for theaters and feature new scenes. The film’s theme song has also been announced as “Rabyu,” a new song written by Tele specifically for the movie.

The new trailer features some of the newly added scenes, as well as a preview of Tele’s theme song. You can check it out below.

The English dub for the anime was released in January 2026. You can see the new key visual drawn by character designer Keita Nagahara below.

The main staff working on Takopi’s Original Sin includes:

• Director: Shinya Iino

• Series Composition: Shinya Iino

• Character Design: Keita Nagahara

• Animation Studio: ENISHIYA

• Production: TBS Television

You can also watch the final PV below. It was released immediately after the finale aired in Japan.

Taizan 5 wrote and illustrated the Takopi’s Original Sin (Takopi no Genzai) manga. It was published on Shueisha’s Shonen Jump+ platform from December 2021 to March 2022, getting a total of 2 compiled volumes. VIZ Media licensed the manga in English, describing the story:

Cute little alien Takopi lands on Earth. What is his mission? To be taken to our leader? No. To spread happiness throughout the universe! The first person Takopi meets is depressed fourth grader Shizuka. (Or is it…?) Takopi is determined to do whatever it takes to make Shizuka smile again. But his misguided attempts to help her by using his advanced technology to turn back time only result in mayhem and death. What is the truth Takopi can’t remember? And what must the pink alien octopus with a heart of gold sacrifice to truly help Shizuka and her friends…?
author: Anime Corner
